metadata.description: Plugins for building, deploying and operating services on ankka.

plugins.name: ankka
plugins.description: The ankka documentation as skills — design, entities, views and consumers, workflows, agents, endpoints, Python, deploying, the platform — and the ankka mcp server.

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Code review as skills: the general checklist every pull request is checked against, then the checklist of each language the diff touches (Scala, Java, Kotlin, Go, Python, Rust, TypeScript); findings labelled by severity with a verdict. Needs nothing from ankka.
